## Schedule and next steps towards submission of proposal FOK-SNP
Info:
- FOK could contribute CHF 10'000 to the project finances.
- Foundations that could be ask for contributions:
  - Dr. Willi Zeller-Stiftung, Eierbrechtstrasse 46, 8053 Zürich, CH
  - Velux Stiftung, https://veluxstiftung.ch/
  - Stiftung zur internationalen Erhaltung der Pflanzenvielfalt, Ballyweg 23, c/o Franz-Xaver Dettling, 6440 Brunnen, CH
  - Stiftung Natur und Wildtiere, Forstackerstrasse 2a, c/o JagdSchweiz, 4800 Zofingen, CH
- The FOK-SNP wants to approve, but cannot decline, the project if there is no fieldwork involved. There is no fieldwork involved.


Decisions:
- Submission of proposal (Projektantrag) to FOK-SNP in February 2026.
- We aim to ask for a contribution of CHF 10'000 by the FOK-SNP for 2027 and CHF 3'000 for 2028.
